integrity: Self-contained proof of sharp minimax, equality and multiplicity; separate finite checker supports but does not prove all prime powers.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes only normalized sums of the indicators of two transverse coordinate lines over odd-characteristic fields. Complex-linear operator tomography, not pure-state condition or global minimax over windows; no independent priority certification.
title: Sharp Gabor tomography conditioning for two-line windows over odd finite fields
